principles: Name the goal and the date you want it by; vague goals stall.
Keep goal money apart from everyday money so it is not spent by accident.
Put money towards it on payday, before you decide how to spend the rest.

gentle.title: Your cushion is in place
gentle.body: Your savings cover about {emergency_fund_months} months of essentials, so you have room to save towards something you want. Giving that money a name and a date makes it easier to stick to. A cash ISA takes up to {fact:isa_allowance} a year tax-free.

blunt.title: Point your savings at a goal
blunt.body: Your savings cover {emergency_fund_months} months of essentials, which is more than a basic cushion. Choose a goal and a date, keep that money separate and put some towards it on payday. A cash ISA takes up to {fact:isa_allowance} a year tax-free.
